R1.description: Every snapshot outcome is counted and reportable, and the baseline, the inherent path-in-use refusal and the kit's zero are recorded

R2.description: A snapshot key holds only what its drive reads, a drive that reads a late part fails loudly, and every life still sees its own late values

R3.description: The review case reaches its plan-gate row once per process and a restored copy matches a fresh build

R4.description: The pages and item records state the mechanism and the measured figures, and the remaining scope items are their own backlog items
